text:
rachel: Hi team — at dinner with a client last night the server "split" the bill incorrectly. corp card charged $420 but my personal card also shows $210 charge. the restaurant says they split two ways but i was supposed to be on the corp charge entirely. attaching photo of both receipts and card portal lines.

frank_finance: thanks @rachel. please paste the transaction ids or a screenshot. we need merchant name, date, amounts, and txn ids to reconcile. also which payment method did you give the server (physical or app)?

rachel: merchant: The Gatehouse, 2026-03-20. Corp txn id: GH-33221 amount $420. Personal txn id: GH-33222 amount $210. i tapped the corporate card for the table; server later charged my personal when trying to split for one attendee who paid cash.

frank_finance: ok. two things: 1) submit expense for personal reimbursement for $210 with note "restaurant split error - pending reconciliation" and attach receipts; 2) we'll reach out to restaurant for an invoice/void on the duplicate personal txn. if restaurant can't void, manager approval required for reimbursement.

amy_manager: i approve this reimbursement - client dinner and company paid for 3/4 of the table per our policy. amy_manager signs off.

reimbot: Expense ticket created: EXP-2026-999. Please attach receipts and manager approval. Expected review 2 business days.

frank_finance: filing a dispute with the card provider for the personal txn as it appears erroneous. @opsbot can you create an audit ticket and schedule a 7 day follow-up?

opsbot: Ticket created: AUD-2026-313. Reminder scheduled in 7 days.

rachel: submitted expense EXP-2026-999 with receipts and manager sign-off. thanks all :pray: 

frank_finance: got it — processing. if dispute is denied we'll honor the manager-approved reimbursement. i'll post updates here.
